blockers.detail: Owned Beta routing queue is empty. Assist Bus reports four active council-beta requests, but the available repository read surface truncated the request payload before those request objects, so requestId/inputSignature/exactQuestion could not be verified without guessing.
blockers.lawfulNextPath: On the next run, re-read the Assist Bus and only execute council-beta assists whose requestId, inputSignature, exactQuestion, packetPath and status are directly observable; do not infer targets from stale evidence filenames or summary counts.

learning.strategy: Preserved lane authority and avoided manufacturing assist identity or repeating stale ticker memory. Digital Twin file was empty and therefore supplied no representation aid.
learning.successDefinition: A future run observes concrete active council-beta assist request objects and produces bounded structural/risk support, or records a changed precise blocker.
